def: a walk, i.e. a passage or a distance

words.word: for how long shall thy journey

occurrences.text: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
words: For how long shall thy journey

occurrences.text: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
